youtube_title: Jesus... Everyone At The Wedding Asked When It's My Turn | Psalms 37:4 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... four aunties asked me the same question today: when is it my turn? 😔

At a family wedding today, relative after relative asked when she would settle down, and she left feeling behind.

She: Jesus... four aunties asked me the same question today: when is it my turn? 😔

She: It was a wedding. I was happy for the couple. But I left feeling like I'm behind.

Jesus: You smiled for every photo and cried in the car on the way home. I was in that car too.

She: Am I doing life wrong? Did I miss some deadline God set for me?

Jesus: There is no deadline with your name on it. Their calendar is not your calling.

She: But everyone from my class is settling down one by one.

Jesus: Let them. Your story is not late. It is being written with more care than you can see tonight.

She: I just don't want to show up at the next one still explaining myself.

Jesus: You never owe anyone an update on your life. Delight yourself in Me, and the rest arrives in its season.

Jesus: Your turn is not a seat at someone else's table. I'm setting a whole table for you.

"Take delight in the Lord , and he will give you the desires of your heart."
Psalms 37:4 (NIV)

You never owe anyone an update on your life. Delight yourself in Me, and the rest arrives in its season.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

What question are you tired of answering? 🙏 Tell us in the comments.
